title: Molecular recording of cellular protein kinase activity with chemical labeling
model: RKO cells with the Kinprola PKA activity recorder, Heidelberg HD CRISPR library A (74,987 guides, 159 non-targeting), sorted into high, basal and low labeling bins
contrast: High vs low Kinprola PKA labeling bin, two independent screens (2 vs 2, basal bins in the fit), lanes summed, library totals
paper_method: limma on log-normalized guide counts, gene-level, Benjamini-Hochberg FDR 0.05
paper_calls: 1,711 genes at FDR 0.05 (2,310 at FDR 0.10); 340 highlighted (FDR 0.05 and |log2 FC| > ~1.1); PRKACA, GNAS, ADCY7 and validated PES1, NOP2, VPRBP, TRIM33, FZR1
barcs_calls: 2,272 genes at FDR 0.10 (1,253 up in high, 1,019 up in low); 2,495 against the control null (centred on targeting guides)
named_hits: Rank by p (both directions): FZR1 #8, ADCY7 #53, PRKACA #62, TRIM33 #181, GNAS #185, VPRBP #239, NOP2 #268, PES1 #420, all FDR < 1e-9 in the paper's direction (8/8)
verdict: BARCS reproduces the PKA-recorder screen: all eight named regulators are called at FDR < 1e-9 in the paper's direction, all 340 highlighted genes pass, the FDR 0.10 lists are the same size (2,272 vs 2,310, 1,613 shared), and gene effects correlate at r = 0.98.
